newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 20.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following business stories on December 20:
NEW YORK - Stocks shot higher on the back of a big bond market rally with the Dow Jones industrial average surging nearly 127 points.
WASHINGTON - Throughout the charity industry, efforts to tap the holiday spirit through solicitations are increasing.
WASHINGTON - Spot shortages of some goods, particularly bakery and dairy items, appeared at some area of Giant Food Inc stores as a strike by truck delivery workers entered its sixth day.

NEW YORK - Former bond trader Joseph Jett, accused of triggering the collapse of Kidder, Peabody & Co with an alleged $350 million securities fraud, won a major victory when an arbitration panel ruled against requiring him to pay damages to the company.
